overall_goal: Check, flip, and continue baking the chicken in the oven

goals.description: Take the chicken out of the oven, flip it, and return it to bake at a higher temperature
goals.rationale: The person clears space, removes the baking tray from the oven, flips the chicken with tongs, and puts it back in the oven while increasing the temperature.

goals.description: Check the chicken a second time for doneness and return it to the oven
goals.rationale: The person takes the baking tray out again, flips the chicken to check if it is cooked, and then places it back into the oven.
